conditions: Quote the source, for example "Source: ECB statistics.", and do not modify the statistics or their metadata. Use them in accordance with the ECB disclaimer. revision_behaviour: The response is the current series, not a historical vintage panel. An unchanged value keeps the first observation id. A changed value is a new row. Official gaps are omitted and are not stored as zero or interpolated. The stored class is latest-revised.
unresolved_questions: The reuse policy does not name AI processing or model training, so those operations stay unknown. One current download cannot reconstruct vintages from before they are collected.
evidence_note: TITLE_COMPL on the current CSV states: Euro area (Member States and Institutions of the Euro Area) changing composition -  HICP - All-items excluding energy and food, Index, European Central Bank (ECB), Working day and seasonally adjusted.
